The 2018 Jeep Grand Cherokee Trailhawk combines genuine Trail Rated capability with the comfort and refinement of a premium SUV. It was ordered with the Trailhawk Luxury Group and the Jeep Active Safety Group, for an original sticker price of $49,925.

Its dealer records include a transmission fluid change, engine mount replacements, front and rear brake pads with new front rotors in 2025, and an oil change with a four-wheel alignment in August 2026.

FOUR-WHEEL DRIVE on the Trailhawk means Quadra-Drive II, Jeep's most capable Grand Cherokee 4x4 system, paired with an electronic rear limited-slip differential and Selec-Terrain traction management. Whether you're climbing a rocky trail, crossing a snowy mountain pass, or simply driving through a nor'easter, it delivers traction and confidence few SUVs can match.
Why Shoppers Buy This Model The Grand Cherokee has been one of America's best-loved SUVs for decades because it does almost everything well. It offers a comfortable, quiet ride, an upscale and spacious cabin, strong towing capability, and legendary Jeep off-road heritage, all in one versatile package that works equally well for commuting, family trips, and weekend adventures.

Compared with rivals like the Ford Explorer, Toyota 4Runner, and Land Rover Discovery, the Grand Cherokee stands out for blending genuine off-road capability with near-luxury refinement. Buyers appreciate that they don't have to choose between a comfortable daily driver and a capable trail machine.
Automotive Press and Industry Recognition Reviewers have long praised this generation of the Grand Cherokee for its refined ride, upscale interior, and impressive breadth of capability. The Trailhawk in particular earns consistent recognition as one of the most off-road-capable midsize SUVs available, combining Trail Rated hardware with a comfortable, feature-rich cabin that makes it easy to live with every day.
Warranty This Grand Cherokee shows exactly 55,889 miles on the odometer. Measured from an estimated in-service date of May 2018, it is beyond the time limits of Jeep's original factory warranty coverage, so that original factory coverage has expired.

At roughly 6,700 miles per year, this Trailhawk has been driven far less than the typical SUV its age. It also comes with an exceptional dealer service history from a single owner, including regular oil changes and tire rotations, brake fluid flushes, a differential fluid service, a transmission fluid change with new transmission seals, engine mount replacements, and a 2025 brake service with new pads front and rear and new front rotors. Extended service plans may be available for buyers who want added peace of mind.
Standard Features The Trailhawk is the Grand Cherokee built for serious off-road adventure. It comes standard with Quadra-Drive II four-wheel drive, Quadra-Lift air suspension, Selec-Terrain traction management, Selec-Speed Control for low-speed trail crawling, and an electronic rear limited-slip differential. Underbody, transfer case, and fuel tank skid plates protect vital components, and red tow hooks are ready for recovery.

The Trailhawk doesn't skimp on comfort, either. It adds heated and ventilated front seats, heated second-row seats, a heated steering wheel, Uconnect 4C NAV with an 8.4-inch display, Keyless Enter-N-Go, and Trailer Tow Group IV. That makes it as comfortable on a long highway drive as it is capable on the trail.

description:
The 2025 Ford Expedition Active represents a comprehensive solution for families and professionals who demand capability, comfort, and advanced technology in a full-size SUV.

- Power Panoramic Vista Roof w/Power Sunshade
- BlueCruise Equipped with 90-day trial
- Ford Co-Pilot360 Active 2.0 with intersection assist and autonomous emergency braking
- Heavy-Duty Trailer Tow with integrated trailer brake control
- 2nd Row Power-Folding Captain's Chairs with 7-passenger seating
- Ford Split Gate with power upper liftgate and power lower tailgate
- 360-Degree Zone Lighting
- Memory Driver Seat with power tilt/telescopic steering wheel memory
- Universal Garage Door Opener
- 20 Carbonized Gray Bright Machined Aluminum Wheels
- Heated Steering Wheel
- Wireless Charging Pad in media hub
- Power-Folding Sideview Mirrors with autofold and memory
- 110V/400W AC Power Outlet with console and cargo area outlets
- Navigation System with SiriusXM 360L

This Active model delivers performance through its EcoBoost 3.5L V6 Twin Turbocharged engine paired with a 10-Speed Automatic transmission and 4WD capability. The two-speed automatic 4WD system includes neutral towing for enhanced versatility whether you're managing daily commutes or weekend adventures.

The cabin prioritizes passenger comfort with heated front captain's chairs, a flex powered console, and thoughtful climate control featuring front dual zone air conditioning and rear air conditioning. The 7-passenger configuration with power-folding second-row captain's chairs and flexible third-row seating accommodates growing families and active lifestyles. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration, combined with SiriusXM 360L, keeps occupants connected throughout every journey.

Safety features include Ford Co-Pilot360 Active 2.0, which encompasses driver state detection, intersection assist, pre-collision assist with autonomous emergency braking, and pedestrian detection. The suite of protective systems dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, and 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS provides confidence for you and your passengers. Front side laminated glass offers additional security.

This Expedition Active comes complete with Ford Gold Certification, including:

- 172 Point Inspection
- Roadside Assistance
- Warranty Deductible: $100
- Transferable Warranty
- Vehicle History
- Limited Warranty: 12 Month/12,000 Mile (whichever comes first) after new car warranty expires or from certified purchase date
- Powertrain Limited Warranty: 84 Month/100,000 Mile (whichever comes first) from original in-service date
- 22,000 FordPass Rewards Points to use toward first two maintenance visits. Only Ford Models, Such as the F150 Truck, F250 Truck and Explorer SUV, Can Become Gold Certified

With 22,513 miles on the odometer, this well-maintained Expedition Active in Blue combines modern capability with proven reliability. The comprehensive warranty coverage, roadside assistance, and FordPass rewards ensure your ownership experience is supported from day one. Visit our showroom to experience how this versatile SUV meets the demands of your family and lifestyle.

The ParkView rear back-up camera makes maneuvering easier, while auto high-beam headlights and front fog lights adapt to changing light conditions. Auto-dimming mirrors and an auto-dimming rear-view mirror reduce glare during varied driving conditions.

Exterior details emphasize quality and durability. Chrome bumpers, chrome exterior mirrors, and the RAM grille badge present a commanding appearance. The MOPAR spray-in bedliner protects your truck bed from the elements, while the remote tailgate release and rear step bumper add practical functionality. Rain-sensitive wipers automatically adjust to weather conditions.

The Malibu LT 1LT combines practicality with modern convenience features that enhance every drive. The heated front seats with the 8-way power driver adjustment and lumbar support ensure you can find your ideal driving position. The premium cloth seating and thoughtfully placed storage compartments create a welcoming environment for every journey.

Technology keeps you connected and informed throughout your drive. The Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Plus system integrates seamlessly with your smartphone through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, while SiriusXM satellite radio provides access to premium content. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your focus on the road.

Safety is engineered throughout this sedan. A comprehensive airbag system, including front, side, and overhead protection, works with electronic stability control and traction control to help protect you and your passengers. The rear parking camera provides visibility when backing up, and OnStar connected services offer additional peace of mind.

We're confident the 2024 Malibu LT will meet your expectations for a dependable, well-equipped sedan. Visit our showroom today to experience its comfort and capability firsthand.
